summary: Hydracore Inc is a privately held, self-owned precision CNC machine shop founded in 1996 and operating a 20,000 sq ft plant in Metuchen, NJ, serving aerospace, defense, medical and heavy-industrial customers from one-off prototypes through high-volume runs. It holds ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100:2016 certification from NQA and is ITAR registered, with a published equipment list (Mori Seiki mill-turn and 5-axis centers, Zeiss Contura CMM, boring mill) and a customer-logo wall that includes large primes and military branches. Outreach is phone/email plus a generic web contact form with no online RFQ or booking path, and the small team (LinkedIn: 11-50 employees, 15 profiles) is actively recruiting a CNC machinist/programmer and a CMM programmer/quality inspector.

facts.fact: Established in 1996 as a privately held precision machine shop based in Metuchen, NJ, operating a 20,000 sq ft facility serving aerospace, defense, medical and heavy industrial customers.
Services are precision CNC machining, prototyping, and low- to high-volume production runs, including individual parts, complex assemblies and long and short runs.
Holds ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100:2016 certification from NQA and is ITAR registered/compliant for defense work.

Published equipment list includes Mori Seiki NT 5400 and NT 4300 mill-turn centers, NMV5000DCG 5-axis mill, NL 3000 and ZT2500Y turning centers, DuraVertical 5100 mill, Zeiss Contura CMM and a Bragonzi horizontal boring mill.
Contact channels listed are email info@hpmmi.com, phone (732) 548-5500, address 215 Liberty St, Metuchen, NJ 08840, and a web contact form.
Careers page has no job listings or ATS; it only invites candidates to fill out a general form for current or future positions.
The facility is described as net zero, powered by solar panels that cover the plant's energy consumption.
Homepage customer-logo assets reference Northrop Grumman, General Dynamics, Curtiss-Wright, Praxair, US Army, US Navy, Stryker, Goodyear and CMC.

LinkedIn lists Hydracore Inc as Manufacturing, 11-50 employees, Self-Owned, founded 1996, headquartered in Metuchen, NJ, with 15 employee profiles and a listed location of 60 Liberty St, Metuchen, NJ 08840.
A company LinkedIn post states Hydracore is growing and is hiring a CNC Machinist/Programmer and a CMM Programmer/Quality Inspector, linking applicants to its Indeed company page.
LinkedIn's public job board shows one open Hydracore role: CNC Machinist and Programmer, Metuchen, NJ, entry level, full-time, posted about two weeks ago.

Site is built on Squarespace; sitemap shows only home, about, capabilities, careers, contact and per-machine equipment pages, with last-modified dates in 2026 (no blog, news or document/data library).

operations_signals: No online quote/RFQ portal, no booking calendar and no live chat anywhere on the site; the only inbound web path is a generic Squarespace contact form plus a published email and phone number (https://www.hpmmi.com/contact)
Contact page funnels all inquiries (new jobs, supplier questions, careers) into one email address and one form, with no routing by inquiry type (https://www.hpmmi.com/contact)
Quoting appears to start from drawings/part files sent by email or discussed by phone; no uploaded-file intake, NDA flow or instant-estimate tool is offered (https://www.hpmmi.com/contact)

Service mix spans one-off prototypes through high-volume runs, implying frequent re-quoting, setup changes and per-job scheduling rather than steady repeat-only work (https://www.hpmmi.com/capabilities)
Published machine list doubles as a capability reference for buyers, but there is no capacity/lead-time information or availability signal (https://www.hpmmi.com/capabilities)
No business hours are published on the home, about, capabilities or contact pages; after-hours coverage is not stated (https://www.hpmmi.com/contact)
Careers intake is a free-text web form with no application tracking or role-specific routing, so resumes and inquiries land in the same inbox as customer messages (https://www.hpmmi.com/careers)
hiring_signals: Company LinkedIn post (about 3 months ago) announces two openings: CNC Machinist/Programmer and CMM Programmer/Quality Inspector, framed as growth hiring (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hydracore-inc_hydracore-inc-jobs-and-careers-activity-7488003627324780544-LxZs)

LinkedIn job board currently shows a single open role, CNC Machinist and Programmer (Metuchen, NJ, entry level, full-time, ~2 weeks old), suggesting repeat or refreshed postings for the same seat (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/hydracore-inc-jobs-worldwide?f_C=5427600)

CMM Programmer/Quality Inspector opening concentrates first-article inspection, AS9100 documentation and dimensional reporting in one hire — a quality/documentation workload signal (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hydracore-inc_hydracore-inc-jobs-and-careers-activity-7488003627324780544-LxZs)

Applicants are routed to the company's Indeed page and to a LinkedIn job poster, i.e. recruiting runs through job boards and manual replies rather than an ATS on the company site (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hydracore-inc_hydracore-inc-jobs-and-careers-activity-7488003627324780544-LxZs; https://www.hpmmi.com/careers)
Indeed's company job page could not be read without passing a bot/verification gate, so the full current posting count there is unverified (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Hydracore-Inc/jobs)
review_themes: No public customer reviews were found: Google Maps place data, Yelp, BBB and Indeed review pages could not be read without login or bot-verification walls, so no review themes can be summarized (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hydracore+Inc,+215+Liberty+St,+Metuchen,+NJ+08840)
Marketing-side trust signals on the company's own site are certification and logo based (NQA certificates, ITAR, customer logos) rather than testimonial or review based (https://www.hpmmi.com)
tech_footprint: Website is a Squarespace build (squarespace-cdn image host, /cart and formatted JSON endpoints) with roughly six content pages and no news/blog section (https://www.hpmmi.com/sitemap.xml)
No CRM, chat widget, booking tool, customer portal or e-commerce flow is visible on any page; there is a dormant site cart link from the template (https://www.hpmmi.com/contact)
No downloadable quality manual, certificate PDFs or spec sheets are published — certifications appear only as logo images (https://www.hpmmi.com/capabilities)

Equipment pages exist per machine (e.g. /nt-5400, /duravertical-5100), indicating a static catalogue-style content approach rather than a searchable capability database (https://www.hpmmi.com/sitemap.xml)
Recruiting footprint is LinkedIn (company page, ~208 followers, job posts) plus an Indeed company page; no careers ATS on the owned site (https://www.linkedin.com/company/hydracore-inc)
growth_signals: Company LinkedIn post explicitly says 'Hydracore is growing' while opening two skilled roles, indicating capacity expansion rather than backfill messaging (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hydracore-inc_hydracore-inc-jobs-and-careers-activity-7488003627324780544-LxZs)

Capabilities page states the shop is 'always updating and adding additional equipment', and the machine list now includes 5-axis and mill-turn capacity plus a Zeiss CMM (https://www.hpmmi.com/capabilities)
Net-zero solar investment is presented as reducing operating costs and improving energy resilience — a capex/sustainability signal unusual for a job shop of this size (https://www.hpmmi.com)

Customer-logo wall spans major aerospace/defense primes, a medical device OEM, an industrial OEM and military branches, suggesting a widening prime-supplier footprint (https://www.hpmmi.com/sitemap.xml)

Two different Liberty St addresses appear in public records (215 Liberty St on the site, 60 Liberty St on LinkedIn), consistent with a campus of adjacent buildings or a recent move/expansion (https://www.hpmmi.com/contact; https://www.linkedin.com/company/hydracore-inc)
decision_maker: Unknown — no owner, president or GM is named anywhere on hpmmi.com (home, about, capabilities, careers, contact). The LinkedIn company page lists Jonathan Foppiano among employees and Samantha Lotfy as the poster on the open CNC Machinist and Programmer job, but no titles are shown publicly, so neither can be confirmed as the decision-maker (https://www.linkedin.com/company/hydracore-inc).

inferences.inference: Quote intake and estimating are manual and email/phone-bound, creating a response-time bottleneck the shop cannot see.
inferences.reasoning: The site offers only a generic contact form and a single info@ inbox, with no RFQ portal, file upload or instant-estimate tool; for a shop quoting prototypes through production runs, each inquiry needs a human to read drawings and price it.

inferences.inference: A meaningful share of inbound inquiries is probably misrouted or slow to answer, including job seekers, suppliers and recruiters hitting the same channels as customers.
inferences.reasoning: Careers, customer contact and general inquiries all terminate in the same form/email with no routing rules, and the careers page explicitly asks candidates to 'fill out the form' with no role-specific path.

inferences.inference: Quality documentation (first-article/inspection reports, AS9100 records, ITAR-controlled handling) is a live capacity constraint.
inferences.reasoning: The company is hiring a CMM Programmer/Quality Inspector as one combined role while also recruiting a machinist/programmer; a ~15-person shop with AS9100 + ITAR obligations typically carries heavy per-job paperwork that scales with part count, not headcount.

inferences.inference: Recruiting is a recurring strain: the same machinist seat appears to be re-advertised across a ~3-month window.
inferences.reasoning: A company post about 3 months old names a CNC Machinist/Programmer opening, and the LinkedIn job board currently shows a CNC Machinist and Programmer role posted ~2 weeks ago, with no ATS or careers listings to build a pipeline.

inferences.inference: Demand is prime-driven and relationship-based, so a low digital footprint is not currently costing them leads — but it limits new-logo acquisition.
inferences.reasoning: The site is a six-page Squarespace brochure with no blog, case studies, spec downloads or reviews, while the visible customer base is large aerospace/defense primes and military programs that buy through qualification and referrals.

inferences.inference: The two Liberty St addresses likely reflect adjacent buildings or a recent relocation/expansion rather than a data error.
inferences.reasoning: The company's own contact page lists 215 Liberty St while its LinkedIn company page lists 60 Liberty St in the same ZIP; both are self-reported by the company, and the shop describes ongoing equipment additions.

inferences.inference: Scheduling and job tracking are probably handled in spreadsheets or a basic ERP with limited customer-facing status visibility.
inferences.reasoning: No portal, status-tracking, or login area exists on the public site, and there is no evidence of published lead times or order-status tools; inference only, no internal system was observed.

data_gaps: No customer reviews retrievable: Google Maps place page renders without review content to non-JS clients, Yelp and Yellowpages returned 403, BBB search returned only a cookie-consent page, and Indeed reviews were behind a verification gate.
Indeed company page (jobs and reviews) blocked by bot verification, so the full current/recent posting list and any employee reviews on Indeed are unverified.

No named decision-maker with a title: the business's own site names no individuals, LinkedIn company page shows employee names without titles, and the individual LinkedIn profile could not be loaded (HTTP 999).
No business hours, after-hours coverage, service-area radius, or shipping/logistics details published on the site.

No local news, award, expansion or trade-press coverage found; web search providers were rate-limited or returned unusable results throughout the session, and site search engines (DuckDuckGo, Mojeek, Bing, SearXNG instances) blocked automated access.
Employee count is inferred from LinkedIn's 11-50 band and 15 visible profiles; no confirmed headcount, revenue or customer-concentration data available.
Address discrepancy (215 vs 60 Liberty St) unresolved — could not confirm which is the current shipping/receiving entrance.
